recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No further core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-29699 unless a future work-group decision changes the searchset self-link conformance rule.
issue_request: FHIR-29699 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking for a Bundle invariant requiring Bundle.type = searchset to have a self Bundle.link with a URL, matching the search conformance text that servers return the parameters actually used in the self link.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 908ab6c031a3144c98da8d4351a8757be7ac9e0f, which added Bundle constraint bdl-18 to source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml. Follow-up commit 1f683a11386b08ebfdb12390f7e8696466fd1e0b refreshed invariant references, and tag v5.0.0 contains the invariant.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists bundle=Bundle, placing source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml in current build scope. Current search.html still contains the motivating self-link conformance rule. Zulip and Confluence evidence support the same scoped searchset invariant and did not reveal a later reversal.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. Current source/bundle/structuredefinition-Bundle.xml contains bdl-18 with expression type = 'searchset' implies link.where(relation = 'self' and url.exists()).exists(), and includes condition references on Bundle.type, Bundle.link, Bundle.link.relation, and Bundle.link.url.
